title: How a Godly Man Works When Nobody's Tracking His Hours
caption:
A godly man's work ethic is worship nobody's watching.

It's the email nobody's grading. The slow Tuesday with nothing due. The day measured by useful, not by busy.

Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord (Colossians 3:23).

Nobody has to see it for it to count. That's exactly why it does.
